WHAT DOES A SENIOR EXPERIENCE DESIGNER - WEB/IVA DO?

The Senior Experience Designer – Web/IVA is a seasoned, hands-on individual contributor operating at the intersection of design, technology, and brand across web and interactive visual aid (IVA) experiences. This role exists to translate creative vision into high-quality, production-ready digital experiences that balance brand expression, user experience, system integrity, and technical feasibility.

Senior Experience Designers are trusted practitioners who operate with a high degree of autonomy, applying sound judgment and deep expertise to navigate complexity, solve execution challenges, and consistently deliver work that meets both creative intent and production requirements. They contribute strategically to execution while remaining deeply engaged in the craft—leading through expertise, influencing design direction, and ensuring quality from concept through implementation.

Success in this role requires strong proficiency in Figma, including a working understanding of variables and design tokens, as well as demonstrated experience designing within code-aligned design systems. Senior Experience Designers collaborate closely with Art, Copy, Experience Architecture (UX), Development, and fellow Experience Designers to create scalable, brand-aware solutions that are creatively compelling, system-aligned, and technically sound.

Our employees deliver exceptional business results through the strength of their expertise, execution, and cross-functional partnerships. For Senior Experience Designers, these results are achieved by:

  • Executing Work Independently: Owning projects from concept through delivery as a trusted individual contributor—working independently or alongside other practitioners based on project scope and complexity.

  • Operating with Minimal Oversight: Exercising sound judgment, maintaining momentum, and ensuring alignment to creative, technical, and production standards with minimal direction.

  • Designing Within Systems: Applying established design systems, components, patterns, tokens, variables, and responsive behaviors to create cohesive, scalable, production-ready Web and IVA experiences.

  • Bridging Craft and Production: Translating creative intent into solutions that respect both the integrity of the brand experience and the realities of development—advocating for strong design while working responsibly within technical, accessibility, regulatory, system, and business requirements.

  • Collaborating Cross-Functionally: Partnering with Art, Copy, Development, and fellow Experience Designers to ensure solutions are creatively aligned, technically feasible, and ready for implementation.

  • Applying Design Judgment: Evaluating tradeoffs, resolving design challenges, incorporating feedback, and making informed execution decisions that balance creative intent, technical feasibility, and production quality.

  • Mentoring Through Practice: Elevating fellow Experience Designers through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and leading by example.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Experience within pharmaceutical or other highly regulated industries.

  • Demonstrated experience designing digital experiences within established design systems.

  • Strong understanding of component-based design, responsive behavior, reusable patterns, and system-driven execution.

  • Strong understanding of the relationship between experience design and front-end development, including the ability to design within technical constraints while advocating for design quality.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Digital Media, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Experience & Training

  • 6+ years of experience in digital, motion, animation, or interactive design.

  • Experience designing HTML media banners within pharmaceutical or other highly regulated industries.

  • Experience contributing to or working within design systems.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Art, Copy, Development, and other designers.

  • Experience optimizing creative for performance marketing objectives.

Technology Proficiency

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (required), including components, variants, Auto Layout, libraries, variables, and design tokens.

  • Demonstrated ability to work efficiently within shared, component-based Figma libraries and established design systems.

  • Working understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into front-end implementation.

  • Familiarity with digital accessibility standards and their application to interface design.

Core Competencies

  • Systems thinker with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to translate strategy and creative vision into scalable execution.

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

  • Clear, confident communicator who can articulate design rationale, constraints, tradeoffs, and recommendations across creative and technical audiences.

  • Ability to operate autonomously while modeling accountability.

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

The Director builds and leads the AI Delivery team, ensuring that delivery velocity never compromises technical excellence, governance compliance, or sustainable scalability.

This position represents the essential bridge between strategic AI vision and operational reality, accountable for transforming Vantage's ambitious AI roadmap into deployable capabilities that measurably advance business objectives. Success requires balancing the urgency of rapid prototyping cycles with the discipline of enterprise architecture, the creativity of innovation with the rigor of governance, and the autonomy of empowered teams with the alignment necessary for organizational coherence.

Essential Job Functions

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and lead a high-performing AI Delivery team that converts approved business requirements into validated, production-ready solutions on committed timelines.

  • Own delivery intake acceptance at the Business Requirements Review Gate, confirming scope, sizing, feasibility, and readiness before work enters delivery, and returning requirements for revision when they are not delivery-ready.

  • Deliver every solution inside the enterprise AI governance framework, embedding ethics, security, and compliance requirements from conception rather than retrofitting controls after development.

  • Orchestrate seamless handoffs from delivery to the Platform and Adoption pillars, providing complete transition packages that enable operational readiness and rollout without rework.

  • Build organizational confidence in AI through successful delivery that demonstrates possibility rather than preaching transformation, earning credibility through consistently met commitments.

Duties:

  • Design and refine the delivery methodology that balances speed with sustainability, creating repeatable processes that deliver working solutions on predictable cycles without creating technical debt or compliance exposure.

  • Build collaborative frameworks between the AI Delivery team and the AI Navigators that leverage operational context for better requirements definition while maintaining technical leadership over solution design.

  • Develop comprehensive transition protocols that enable clean handoffs into production, including technical specifications, solution design documentation, architectural decisions, and success criteria that prevent rework during platform and adoption transition.

  • Apply the AI Organization's governance standard within delivery processes, including gate readiness, documented handoffs, and current status in the system of record, so ethics and compliance are built in rather than treated as afterthoughts.

  • Develop metrics and reporting that demonstrate AI delivery impact through business value quantification, adoption rates, velocity improvements, and quality indicators that build executive confidence in transformation progress.

  • Build talent development programs within AI delivery teams that cultivate technical excellence, business acumen, and collaborative capability, creating career pathways that retain high performers while continuously elevating team capabilities.

Additional Duties:

  • Handle additional duties as assigned by Leadership.

Job Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related technical field with substantial experience leading AI/ML delivery teams in enterprise environments; advanced degrees valuable but not required when offset by demonstrated success building and scaling AI capabilities that generated measurable business impact.

  • Proven track record establishing delivery methodologies that balance innovation velocity with technical quality, having led teams that consistently delivered validated solutions while maintaining governance compliance and architectural coherence.

  • Experience in data center operations, infrastructure projects, or construction management highly desirable as it provides essential context for understanding Vantage's operational environment and the specific friction points AI can address.

  • Comfort operating in high-velocity environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements, demonstrating resilience through organizational change while maintaining team morale and delivery commitments.

  • Ability to build collaborative relationships across organizational boundaries, having successfully partnered with IT, Security, Legal, Compliance, and business functions to deliver solutions that meet diverse stakeholder requirements.

This role will lead the European category management process for designated categories while also managing supplier sourcing and procurement activities for selected growth projects. All activities will align with Sysco’s legal, sustainability, brand, and FSQA standards to drive profitable category growth and support strategic business expansion.

This position offers a remote working arrangement from anywhere within the UK or Europe.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the creation of optimised product ranges for Europe as a whole for Frozen Vegetables, Frozen Fruits and Frozen Potato categories, balancing European scale opportunities with local market needs.
  • Lead the development and execution of category strategies, assortment architecture, supplier portfolio and innovation roadmaps for these categories.
  • Manage the full end-to-end product lifecycle, identifying opportunities for product launches, range optimisation and discontinuations.
  • Partner closely with local merchandising, commercial and procurement teams to ensure category strategies deliver sustainable growth and customer relevance.
  • Make fact-based decisions using Sysco internal data, supplier insights, market intelligence, competitor analysis and category performance data.
  • Drive category growth, profitability and Sysco Brand penetration across assigned categories.
  • Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships, supporting innovation, performance improvement and long-term partnership objectives.
  • Identify and proactively mitigate supply chain and market risks within the category portfolio.

Buying Responsibilities (30-40%)

  • Lead sourcing activities for new strategic projects and emerging categories, including convenience products and other growth platforms.
  • Act as both Buyer and Category Manager for assigned development projects, managing supplier selection, negotiations, commercial terms and range development.
  • Identify, evaluate and onboard new suppliers that support Sysco’s growth ambitions, quality standards and sustainability objectives.
  • Deliver procurement initiatives that generate value through cost optimisation, innovation, service improvement and supply security.
  • Collaborate with FSQA, Supply Chain, Sustainability and Commercial teams to ensure successful product implementation and supplier compliance.
  • Support business case development and strategic decision-making related to new product and category opportunities.

You

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic and evolving international environment and brings a strong blend of Category Management and Purchasing expertise.

You will have significant experience in category management, sourcing and supplier management, ideally within foodservice, retail, FMCG or the food manufacturing industry. You are comfortable balancing long-term category strategy with hands-on procurement and negotiation activities.

You have a proven track record of driving sales, margin improvement, category growth and procurement value through effective category management and commercial sourcing strategies. You are highly analytical and able to leverage consumer insights, supplier intelligence, market data and financial analysis to support fact-based decision-making.

Experience managing cross-functional projects, launching new product ranges, and negotiating with suppliers at a European or international level would be highly advantageous.

You are proactive, resilient and collaborative, with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple countries and functions. Proficiency in English is required, with additional European languages considered an asset.

jobs.excerpt: You'll be the founding technical lead for Veris EvalOps, building the platform that answers the two questions every AI-deploying business needs answered: is this system safe to launch, and is it still working correctly a month later.
jobs.description:
You'll be the founding technical lead for Veris EvalOps, building the platform that answers the two questions every AI-deploying business needs answered: is this system safe to launch, and is it still working correctly a month later. You'll take it from first line of code to first paying clients in 6–7 months.

Role Summary

This is a zero-to-one build, not a maintenance role. You'll architect and ship two commercial modules — a pre-production Release Gate that turns “looks good” into a reproducible readiness score, and a Knowledge Health Monitor that continuously audits the knowledge base an AI draws from — while hiring and leading the engineers who build them alongside you. There's no principal architect above you to escalate to: you make the calls and live with them, with the first pilot client live by month 3.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the evaluation engine. LLM-as-judge scoring, rule-based checks, groundedness verification, hallucination detection, and regression comparison — every readiness score comes from here.

• Build the tracing and observability layer. Distributed tracing across LLM calls, RAG retrievals, and agent workflows, built on OpenTelemetry, capturing every token, tool call, cost, and latency metric.

• Ship the knowledge health pipeline. Ingestion and continuous analysis of enterprise knowledge sources — stale-content detection, contradiction analysis, and coverage-gap mapping.

• Own platform core and integrations. Multi-tenant architecture, RBAC, API connectors, dashboards, and the CI/CD hooks that let the Release Gate plug into client engineering workflows.

• Build and lead the team. Hire and run 5–7 engineers across three streams — Platform Core, Release Gate, Knowledge Health — and own every architecture decision end to end.

Must-have

• 5+ years in engineering. Including 2+ years leading a team of 3–8 through a complete build cycle — architecture to shipping to paying users. Not a first-time lead role.

• LLM evaluation methodology. LLM-as-judge design, RAGAS/DeepEval-style metrics, golden dataset construction, regression testing for AI systems, and hallucination detection — not just the library calls, the mechanics behind them.

• LLM observability and tracing. OpenTelemetry-based tracing across LLM calls, RAG retrievals, and multi-step agent trajectories; cost/latency attribution; drift and anomaly detection.

• RAG system architecture. Production experience across the full pipeline — chunking, embeddings, a vector store (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector), retrieval, re-ranking.

• AI agent systems. Production experience with agent patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, supervisor/sub-agent), tool-call evaluation, and guardrails.

• Backend platform engineering. Production-grade async Python (FastAPI, Celery), multi-tenant SaaS architecture, PostgreSQL/Redis, and CI/CD integration.

• Build-vs-integrate judgment and client-facing comfort. Can weigh integrating Langfuse/Braintrust vs. building from scratch, and work directly with pilot clients during onboarding and results review.

Nice-to-have

• LLM APIs and model ecosystem. Multi-provider experience (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock) and routing/prompt-management at scale.

• MLOps and experiment tracking. Background with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent experiment-tracking tooling.

• Security, compliance, and AI governance. EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF awareness, PII handling in AI pipelines, and red-teaming basics — increasingly a qualification question in enterprise security reviews.

We help global businesses deliver faster and build smarter — combining AI-driven development practices with deep expertise across fintech, healthcare, retail, and enterprise technology. Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage — and we build our teams accordingly.

jobs.description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $45 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are building the client's AWS enterprise cloud foundation from the ground up, and we are building it with an Agentic Software Development Life Cycle (Agentic-SDLC). We are not looking for an architect who reviews what agents produced. We are looking for one who builds the agents, defines the intents they execute, and treats the delivery system itself as part of the architecture they own.

This is the senior technical seat on the account. You will own the architecture across workstreams — the multi-account AWS landing zone (Network, Shared Services, and Workload Non-Prod and Prod), the application architecture running on top of it, and the platform architecture that comes next. You will also lead the operational team as tech lead: setting the technical direction, unblocking engineers, and shipping code yourself. This is a hands-on role. The person who owns the diagram is the person who writes the CDK.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Ownership: Own the AWS enterprise architecture end to end — multi-account governance and guardrails, Transit Gateway topology, hybrid connectivity to on-premises data centers, centralized traffic inspection, hybrid DNS, and the security posture that holds it all together. You write the ADRs, you defend them to the client, and you revisit them when they stop being true.
  • Tech Leadership with Your Hands On: Lead the operational team day to day — technical direction, design review, code review, and the architectural decisions that unblock delivery. You are also expected to build: CDK stacks, Lambda functions, agent tooling.
  • Agent Development & Orchestration: Design and extend the agents that carry our delivery — intent decomposition, design artifact generation, implementation scaffolding, validation, and gate reporting. Author the capability instructions they run on so agents produce architecture-compliant work without a human restating the standards each time. When you see the same correction made twice, you encode it once.
  • Intent-Driven Execution: Work within our Intent-Driven Framework, where intent describes client outcomes rather than task lists, ambiguity stops execution instead of getting interpreted, and every user-visible change ships behind a feature flag. High-velocity delivery in fixed-scope cycles, without scope creep or accumulated technical debt.
  • Legacy Modernization: Help systematically retire a live VB6 desktop application by moving its functionality into cloud services, while the legacy system keeps running untouched. Coexistence design — read-only replication, parity proof, staged cutover — is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought.
  • Platform Direction: Lead the platform evaluation for the external digital front: understand what the client's dealers and commercial customers actually need, assess the options, and produce a recommendation leadership and the client can act on. Then design the reuse path — external identity, tenancy, API contracts that hold once a partner integrates against them.
  • Client-Facing Architecture: Be the person in the room with the client's IT and security leadership explaining why the design is what it is, and the person who translates their constraints back into design changes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Cloud Architecture Depth: +7 years of experience in software engineering and +4 years of experience with architecture, on production systems you were accountable for. Serverless application architecture — API Gateway, Lambda, CloudFront, Cognito with SAML federation, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and X-Ray.
  • Infrastructure as Code, Exclusively: AWS CDK in TypeScript, with opinions about stack boundaries and construct design. No console provisioning, no drift.
  • Software Engineering: Java and TypeScript at a level where you can review and write, not just discuss. Our stack is Java 25 with Spring Cloud Function on Lambda, React 19 with TypeScript, CDK in TypeScript. REST contract design, versioning, and backward compatibility. GitHub Actions with OIDC-based cloud authentication.
  • AI/ML Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Agentic Frameworks (e.g. Claude Agent SDK, Strands, LangChain, or CrewAI). Tool and MCP integration, context engineering, and a real point of view on how agent output gets verified at a scale where you cannot read all of it. AWS Bedrock and AgentCore are a plus.
  • Hybrid and Legacy Reality: Experience shipping something that had to coexist with a system nobody was allowed to touch.

Soft Skills

  • Adaptive and Agentic Mindset: Ability to pivot quickly. You should be comfortable with a "startup within a corporate" feel where priorities shift based on impact, and where the highest-value thing this week was not on the plan two weeks ago.
  • Architectural Thinking: Understanding of the "Agentic SDLC" and the ability to build systems that reduce human intervention over time. You should find it satisfying, not threatening, when something you used to do by hand becomes automatic.

jobs.title: U.S. Tax Reviewer, Small Business Returns
jobs.excerpt: The U. S.  Tax Reviewer reviews prepared tax returns for accuracy, completeness, customer readiness, filing risk, and alignment with the customer’s books and supporting documentation.
jobs.description:
The U.S. Tax Reviewer reviews prepared tax returns for accuracy, completeness, customer readiness, filing risk, and alignment with the customer’s books and supporting documentation. This is a quality-control and customer-protection role, not a passive sign-off step.

The ideal candidate can identify material tax errors, catch bookkeeping inconsistencies, validate adjustments, review Form 6765/R&D credit items where applicable, communicate clearly with preparers, and support or conduct customer draft review conversations when needed. The reviewer owns follow-through until the return is corrected, customer-ready, approved, filed, or clearly reassigned.

Core Responsibilities

  • Review prepared federal and applicable state returns before customer delivery or filing, including 1040, Schedule C, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065 returns.

  • Confirm returns align with year-end financials, bookkeeping records, workpapers, prior-year context, and customer-provided documents.

  • Identify material errors, inconsistencies, missing schedules, classification issues, unsupported positions, filing risks, and bookkeeping issues requiring correction before filing.

  • Validate adjusting entries or request corrections before customer delivery or filing.

  • Review returns involving R&D credits / Form 6765 where applicable, including reasonableness of inputs, documentation, and escalation needs.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to preparers and ensure corrections are completed before a return is sent to the customer or filed.

  • Conduct or support draft review calls when technical explanation is needed and explain review findings in plain language.

  • Confirm customer approval is informed and filing authorization matches the correct return and year.

  • Monitor returns in review, client approval, and filing stages so they do not stall; respond promptly to internal and customer-facing questions.

  • Document review findings, decisions, assumptions, unresolved risks, and follow-up items clearly.

  • Escalate advisory or complex technical issues to BenchTax Advisors only when necessary, and track repeat preparer issues to support quality improvement.

  • With Power of Attorney, communicate with IRS agents in writing and on calls on behalf of the customer.

  • Understand IRS notices and explain next steps to customers; offering first time abatement letters when appropriate.

  • Prepare and file amendments.

Required Qualifications

  • Valid IRS PTIN.

  • Significant U.S. tax preparation and/or review experience.

  • Strong understanding of small business and entity-level tax issues.

  • Ability to review 1040, Schedule C, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065 returns.

  • Ability to identify material tax errors, bookkeeping inconsistencies, unsupported positions, and filing risks, and explain corrections clearly.

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, written/verbal communication, and remote-work discipline.

  • Comfort speaking directly with customers by phone or video when needed and explaining technical tax issues to non-tax professionals.

  • Strong computer skills and ability to work efficiently across multiple systems in a remote workflow.

  • Independent ownership, responsiveness, and follow-through through correction, approval, and filing.

  • Willingness to complete BenchTax’s written technical review assessment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or Enrolled Agent designation strongly preferred.

  • Big 4 Experience strongly preferred.

  • Experience with R&D credits and Form 6765, including reviewing documentation/substantiation and identifying when specialist/advisor review is required.

  • Experience reviewing returns for startups, software companies, engineering firms, product-development businesses, or other R&D-heavy clients.

  • Prior experience as a senior preparer, reviewer, tax manager, or quality reviewer.

  • Experience reviewing returns prepared by others in a high-volume tax operation.

  • Experience with Drake Tax or similar professional tax software.

  • Experience with remote workflows and tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, portals,

Shared Expectations

  • Growth and development: coachable, receives and delivers feedback continuously and constructively; seeks opportunities to improve our processes and systems to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Customer communication: comfortable with phone/video calls, written messages, draft review calls, and plain-language explanations of tax outcomes.

  • Ownership and follow-through: acknowledges assignments, provides status updates, documents blockers, follows through on commitments, and escalates before deadlines or customer experience are at risk.

  • Prioritization: organized and works on competing priorities with a discerning mindset in a fast paced environment with little direction.

  • Bookkeeping and adjustment awareness: understands that tax preparation depends on accurate books and recognizes when financial records do not support the return.

  • Remote-work and computer skills: highly comfortable using tax software, customer portals, Slack or similar tools, Google Workspace, CRM/workflow systems, dashboards, shared trackers, and multiple browser-based systems.

  • Quality and metrics: comfortable being measured on accuracy, avoidable rework, response time, turnaround time, SLA adherence, workpaper/note quality, customer impact, and ability to move work forward without unnecessary escalation.

  • Must be based in the Pune area and available to work North American business hours (8 AM – 4 PM EST or PST)
  • Must meet Bench’s minimum hardware and internet requirements for smooth communication and workflow

BenchTax is building an in-house U.S. tax preparation and review function focused on quality, turnaround time, customer experience, accountability, and cost control.

We are hiring experienced U.S. tax professionals to support small business customers across common filing types, including 1040, Schedule C, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065 returns.

These are not data-entry roles. We need tax professionals who can prepare or review returns accurately, identify when bookkeeping issues affect tax accuracy, communicate directly with customers, explain tax concepts in plain language, document work clearly, and move files forward without constant follow-up.

Candidates must have a valid IRS PTIN. CPA or Enrolled Agent designation is preferred. Experience with R&D credits and Form 6765 is strongly preferred.

jobs.excerpt: About PhaidraPhaidra is building the future of industrial automation.
jobs.description:
About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

  • We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
  • We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
  • We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency,Velocity, Craft, and Truth. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR. Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.

Who You Are

Research Scientists at Phaidra lead our efforts in developing novel algorithmic architecture towards the end goal of bringing intelligent control systems to industrial sector.

Having pioneered research in the world's leading academic and industrial labs as PhDs, post-docs or professors, Research Scientists join Phaidra to work collaboratively within and across research fields.

Drawing on expertise from a variety of disciplines including model-based reinforcement learning, planning and optimal control, deep learning, world models, and safe reinforcement learning, our Research Scientists are at the forefront of groundbreaking research and applying it to real-world industrial control systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evaluate model-based reinforcement learning agents — including planning-based controllers (MPC, MPPI) — and the software prototypes needed to deploy them on real industrial control systems.
  • Develop learned dynamics and world models (learned surrogates) that generalize across systems, including the training pipelines — pretraining, curriculum learning, active/adversarial learning, and fine-tuning — needed to make them reliable for planning and control.
  • Research and implement methods for e.g. safe RL, constrained control, scenario planning and Bayesian RL, to develop agents that satisfy safety constraints during deployment.
  • Report and present research findings and developments including status and results clearly and efficiently both internally and externally, verbally and in writing.
  • Participate in and organize ambitious collaborative research projects, and work with external collaborators and partners to translate research into production outcomes.
  • Mentor and guide Research Engineers to apply research findings and developments to industrial domains.
  • Independently defines new research directions
  • Translates research into practical outcomes
  • Owns the development and rollout for an entire research area or large project

Key Qualifications

  • PhD in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with a strong background in model-based reinforcement learning and demonstrated knowledge in one or more of the following:
    • Planning algorithms
    • World models / learned dynamics surrogates
    • Reinforcement Learning and Deep Learning
    • Control Theory
    • Safe / constrained RL
  • Either:
    • 2+ years of research experience in academia or industry after PhD graduation.
    • 5+ years of research experience in academia or industry after Master’s graduation.
  • Extensive research in the fields of {ModelBased, ModelFree, Safe} RL and Control Theory, with particular depth in model-based methods.
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating agents against simulators (e.g. differentiable simulators or world models) and closing the sim-to-real gap.
  • Alignment with Phaidra's values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, & Truth.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • PhD in machine learning, control, or a closely related field.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with model-based RL and planning agents applied to real-world dynamical or industrial systems.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including vectorized/differentiable simulators and scaling experiments on distributed compute (e.g. Ray, Kubernetes, GCP).
  • A proven track record of publications in RL, control, or a related area.
  • A real passion for AI and applying it to industrial systems to improve resource efficiency.

Our Stack

  • Python
  • PyTorch, scipy
  • Kubernetes, Docker, Ray
  • GCP

Onboarding

In your first 30 days...

  • You will be immersed in an onboarding program that introduces you to Phaidra and our product.
  • You will spend time in the research team and get introduced to the different tracks of research that we perform.
  • You will learn how other teams operate, interact, and approach problems.
  • You will read various parts of our handbook and familiarize yourself with the documentation culture at Phaidra.
  • You will set up your development environment and get introduced to various parts of our code base.

By your first 60 days...

  • You will have a solid understanding of what Phaidra does and how we do it.
  • You will have met with team members across Phaidra and started building relationships that will help you be successful at your job.
  • You will have a good understanding of our research tracks, which allowed you to form a plan for your first project, or maybe, you have already started one.

By your first 90 days...

  • You will have been fully integrated in the team and with team members across the company.
  • You will have started to contribute to knowledge sharing throughout Phaidra.
  • Your project is in full swing and you might have some early results already.

General Interview Process

All of our interviews are held via Google Meet, and an active camera connection is required.

  1. Meeting with People Operations team member (30 minutes)
  2. Meeting with Hiring Manager (30 minutes)
  3. Technical Conversation with Research team member (60 minutes)
  4. Technical Conversation with Hiring Manager (60 minutes)
  5. Culture fit interview with Phaidra’s co-founders (30 minutes)

Base Salary

UK Residents:
  • Tier 1 (London): 96,159 GBP - 132,219 GBP
  • Tier 2 (Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Bristol): 90,502 GBP - 124,441 GBP
  • Tier 3 (Smaller cities / rural areas): 84,847 GBP - 116,664 GBP

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for equity. Final salary will be determined based on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, expertise, education and location. In some cases, final compensation may fall outside the posted range. Salary ranges are regularly reviewed and may be adjusted in response to market trends.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fast-paced, team-oriented environment where your work directly shapes the company’s direction.
  • We are a 100% remote company.
  • Competitive compensation & meaningful equity.
  • Outsized responsibilities & professional development.
  • Training is foundational; functional, customer immersion, and development training.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance (exact benefits vary by region).
  • Unlimited paid time off, with a required minimum of 20 days per year.
  • Paid parental leave (exact benefits vary by region).
  • Flexible stipends to support your workspace, well-being, and continued professional development.
  • Company MacBook.

Please note: Not all of Phaidra’s benefits and perks listed above apply to temporary employees such as interns.

On being Remote

We take a thoughtful and intentional approach to remote collaboration. Inspired by pioneers like GitLab, we embrace proven best practices to foster an exceptional remote work environment. Our culture is documentation-first, and we prioritize asynchronous communication to support focus and flexibility across time zones. While we value independence, we stay closely connected through tools like Slack and video conferencing. Weekly all-hands meetings help us align and build strong relationships, and we regularly host virtual team-building activities and social events to maintain a sense of camaraderie.

Equal Opportunity Employment

Phaidra is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Phaidra is governed on the basis of merit, competence, and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status. We welcome diversity and strive to maintain an inclusive environment for all employees. If you need assistance with completing the application process, please contact us at .

E-Verify Notice

Phaidra participates in E-Verify, an employment authorization database provided through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and Social Security Administration (SSA). As required by law, we will provide the SSA and, if necessary, the DHS, with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization for those residing in the United States.

Additional information about E-Verify can be found here.

To be considered for any position at Phaidra, you must submit an online application. This role will remain open until it is filled.

Phaidra only hires individuals who are legally authorized to work in the specified location(s) above. We do not provide employment sponsorship. Candidates requiring visa sponsorship, either now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

jobs.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

As a Director of Product on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with that game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
  • Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
  • Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
  • Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
  • Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
  • Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
  • Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
  • Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy,, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG, with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

Product & RPG expertise

  • Product experience on live F2P mobile games, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
  • Strong fluency in RPG mechanics and meta systems: progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
  • Ideally, you’ve taken a title from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

LiveOps & Execution

  • Deep LiveOps experience, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
  • Strong track record owning features end-to-end: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of what a live team can realistically ship and maintain, balancing ambition with feasibility.

Leadership & Ways of working

  • Strong cross-functional leadership, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
  • A strategist and builder: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands-on with the game, systems and data.
  • Thrives in lean, fast-moving, high-autonomy teams with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership.


Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough.”
  • Humility: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we dive deep into the details.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.

  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Fullstack Engineer on the Duo Client SDK team at GitLab, you'll build the shared foundation for every GitLab Duo client. Today, the logic that powers Duo in editors lives inside the GitLab Language Server. We're extracting it into a true software development kit (SDK): a set of well-versioned TypeScript packages that editor extensions, our web-based Duo Chat on GitLab.com, and eventually external applications can use.

You'll work in TypeScript across frontend and backend systems. You'll design the SDK's Node.js core and public application programming interface (API), and work in the clients that use it. The work rewards care about interfaces, versioning, and backward compatibility as much as features because other engineers will depend on what you build.

You'll have senior and staff engineers alongside you to help with design. You'll own the implementation of scoped packages and ship improvements with minimal guidance while collaborating with the team on larger architectural changes.

Some examples of our projects:

  • The Duo Client SDK, extracting versioned, publishable packages from the GitLab Language Server
  • The GitLab Language Server, rebuilt on top of the SDK as our polyglot surface
  • Duo Chat on the web, as one of the SDK's first consumers

What you'll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, and performant TypeScript features that solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.
  • Ship small features and improvements with minimal guidance, writing tests with every merge request and contributing to code reviews and design discussions.
  • Extract and publish TypeScript packages from the GitLab Language Server, migrating consumers incrementally so no parallel implementation is left to drift.
  • Design durable public APIs with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, changelogs, and deprecation paths for external consumers.
  • Build isomorphic core packages that isolate platform-specific behavior in adapters at the edges.
  • Build and improve SDK client surfaces, including Vue 3 components in Duo Chat on the web, in collaboration with product, design, and engineering teams.
  • Strengthen credential handling across hosts, including bearer tokens, session cookies, and CSRF protection.
  • Optimize bundle size, startup cost, and dependency weight for browser consumers, and support a Tier 2 on-call rotation for urgent engineering issues.

What you'll bring

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript across frontend and backend systems, including experience building and maintaining Node.js services.
  • Experience with modern build and packaging tools, including monorepos, multi-module builds, ECMAScript modules (ESM), and dependency management.
  • Experience with Vue 3 and the Composition API, or comparable component-based frontend experience and a willingness to learn Vue.
  • Experience designing APIs that other people use, with the ability to explain what you'd do differently.
  • Understanding of the differences between running code in Node.js and in the browser, and how to write code that works in both.
  • A security-minded development approach, including careful credential handling and performance optimization.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in writing about technical problems, propose iterative solutions, and work effectively in an agile environment.
  • Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, and the judgment to ask for help when needed while thriving in a fully remote organization aligned with GitLab's values.

About the team

The Duo Client SDK team sits in GitLab's AI Clients stage and works closely with teams building GitLab Duo experiences. We collaborate across client surfaces to make thoughtful technical decisions as the platform evolves. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across regions, in the open, following GitLab's values of transparency and open communication.

Data Governance Analyst

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Data Governance Analyst will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's data governance framework so that data is managed and protected as a strategic enterprise asset and to accelerate CMM modernization efforts. This role acts as a Data Standards Architect, defining and documenting data standards, definitions, and structures across systems, and works closely with legal, compliance, security, and business stakeholders to ensure data is handled in accordance with privacy, security, retention, classification, and regulatory requirements. This role also ensures alignment with Judiciary policies, practices, and the current Data Governance Roadmap, and fosters a data driven culture across the AO and local courts.

The Data Governance Analyst will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the CMM Data Governance framework, policies, standards, procedures, and operating models.
  • Serve as a Data Standards Architect, define, document, and maintain data standards, naming conventions, data definitions, data structures, reference data, and governance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain data governance standards aligned with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, records management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models.
  • Partner with Data Stewards, Data Owners, business stakeholders, security, privacy, legal, records management, and technology teams to operationalize governance requirements.
  • Ensure data assets are appropriately classified and managed based on sensitivity, criticality, and business value.
  • Support compliance with data privacy, security, retention, classification, records management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate policies and regulatory requirements into actionable data governance controls and procedures.
  • Identify governance gaps, risks, and areas of non-compliance and coordinate remediation activities.
  • Support data access, sharing, usage, and lifecycle governance processes.
  • Participate in governance councils, working groups, and data domain forums.
  • Develop governance documentation, standards, procedures, decision logs, and supporting artifacts.
  • Monitor adoption and effectiveness of governance policies and standards.
  • Support governance-related assessments, audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Contribute to the development of data governance roadmaps, maturity assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the data stewardship program by defining data ownership roles, responsibilities, and RACI models across business and technical teams.
  • Develop training materials and deliver awareness sessions on data governance policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Track, analyze, and report data governance program metrics, maturity, and compliance status to leadership and governance councils.

  • MA/MS degree with 5+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in supporting enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience translating governance policy into practical operational processes in delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of data quality management, metadata practices, and stewardship models.
  • Experience governing high-sensitivity or regulated data with clear compliance expectations.
  • Experience with data quality profiling and monitoring techniques and common tooling patterns.
  • Experience defining and governing enterprise data standards across multiple teams and delivery pods.
  • Strong background in data modeling, integration patterns, and change data capture concepts.
  • Experience with metadata and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, or Qlik.
  • Practical experience implementing glossary and lineage capabilities in modern data platforms.
  • Ability to translate technical metadata into business-friendly definitions and documentation.
  • Experience implementing data privacy controls in regulated or high-sensitivity environments.
  • Experience with access management and operationalizing privacy requirements.
  • Experience partnering with security, governance, and engineering teams to implement compliant data sharing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Federal Government or regulated environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models.
  • Data management certification.

Sargent & Lundy is forming a new team within the Training & Development group. This team will complement our existing Instructional Design and Training Implementation teams, providing dedicated support to internal and external instructor-led training initiatives for our Nuclear Power Group.

About the Team

Our Total Rewards team designs and runs the benefits programs that support Mixpanel employees around the world. We work closely with People, Finance, Legal, and regional teams to build programs that are fair, competitive, and easy to understand, because how we take care of our people is part of how we build trust across the company.

About the Role

As our Global Benefits Manager, you'll own how Mixpanel designs, delivers, and governs benefits programs across every country we operate in. You'll work independently on ambiguous, cross-functional problems, like a new country launch, a plan redesign, or an M&A integration, and turn them into clear, workable plans. People across HR, Finance, Legal, and regional teams will look to you as the person who understands both the details and the bigger picture of how benefits decisions affect our people and our business. This role doesn't manage people directly, but it does lead initiatives that span multiple functions and calls for confidence making decisions without a fully defined brief.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and ongoing improvement of health, retirement, wellness, and leave programs across multiple countries, balancing local requirements with one consistent philosophy.
  • Scope and lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives, such as country expansions, M&A integrations, and plan redesigns, by defining the problem, identifying the right stakeholders, and choosing an approach without a fully written brief.
  • Own vendor and broker relationships globally, including renewal negotiations, and hold partners accountable to cost and service commitments.
  • Serve as Mixpanel's go-to resource on benefits compliance (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, GDPR, and international equivalents), monitoring regulatory change and assessing its impact.
  • Analyze program cost and utilization data to find savings and inform annual budgeting, then turn findings into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Build benefits education and self-service resources that make complex programs easy for employees to understand and use.
  • Apply AI and other new tools where they meaningfully speed up reporting, analysis, or employee support, and share what works with the wider People team.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Led complex, ambiguous, cross-functional projects independently, not just executed a defined process, and can point to specific examples.
  • A working understanding of benefits and employment compliance frameworks, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, and international equivalents like GDPR.
  • Experience managing vendors, brokers, or carriers, including negotiating renewals and holding partners to service commitments.
  • A track record of turning cost and utilization data into a recommendation others can act on.
  • Comfort adopting new tools, including AI, to make existing work faster or better, and a habit of sharing what works with others.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to adjust tone for employees, partners, vendors, and senior leaders, especially when the news is complicated.
  • Sound judgment operating with a high degree of independence in a fast-changing, multi-country environment.
  • A degree in human resources, business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with global benefits platforms such as Paylocity or Bswift.
  • Relevant certifications, such as CEBS, PHR, or SHRM-CP.
  • Experience supporting benefits through an M&A integration or new country entry.
  • Familiarity building benefits programs in a high-growth, distributed company.

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
  • Mental Wellness Benefit
  • Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
  • Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
  • One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
  • Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
  • Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
  • Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

jobs.excerpt: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
jobs.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

Position overview

We’re looking for a Solution Architect to join our engineering function, reporting directly to the CTO. At Xapo, we are building truly cross-functional teams with full ownership of design, architecture, building, testing, delivery, data, and operations, structured as Stream Aligned Teams (SATs), Platform teams and Enabling teams as per Team Topologies. You will collaborate closely with engineering leaders and the SRE function, as well as fellow members of the product, apps, and design.

This is a deeply hands-on role. You will not sit on top of an ivory tower drawing boxes and arrows, you will write code, build production-grade Proofs of Concept and demonstrate what good looks like by example. You will own the Architectural Advice Forum (AAF), facilitating decentralised architectural decisions captured as ADRs without becoming a bottleneck or single point of approval.

You will be the CTO’s partner on AI strategy, drive standardisation across backend, web and mobile engineering, and work closely with our SRE team on reliability, observability and platform concerns.

This is an opportunity to shape how a regulated crypto bank designs, builds and operates software, having a real impact on how the future of finance looks.

Responsibilities

  • Own and facilitate the Architectural Advice Forum (AAF), driving decentralised decision-making that is captured as ADRs. The forum is yours, the challenge is expected, but you are not “single” approver of every architectural change, the goal is for decisions to be made as close to the teams doing the work as possible.
  • Personally build production-grade Proofs of Concept to de-risk new patterns, validate architectural ideas and demonstrate “what good looks like” ahead of broader adoption.
  • Partner with the CTO on Xapo’s AI strategy, identifying high-value opportunities, evaluating tooling, prototyping solutions and helping engineering teams adopt AI responsibly across the SDLC and our customer-facing products.
  • Own cross-cutting standardisation across backend, web and mobile engineering, patterns, paradigms, observability, security, testing and delivery, so that quality and velocity scale together.
  • Define and uphold the engineering quality bar across backend, web and mobile, covering testing, code review, observability, security, performance and production-readiness, and lead by example through your own POCs and code reviews
  • Embed Security-First Architecture across everything we build. For a regulated crypto bank, security is not a checkbox or a separate workstream, it is the DNA of our products. You will set the threat-modelling, secure-by-default and defence-in-depth patterns that every team builds against, and partner with our Security function to evolve them as our risk surface grows.
  • Champion Domain-Driven Design and Event-Driven Architecture as foundations for how we model our domain and evolve our systems.
  • Work closely with the SRE team on reliability, capacity, incident response, observability and the evolution of our internal developer platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers across SATs, platform and enabling teams, leading through inspiration and influence rather than authority, and helping the whole organisation raise its architectural bar.
  • Surface and unblock systemic technical risks, technical debt and cross-team dependencies before they hit production.
  • Maintain Xapo’s engineering principles and Tech Radar, and contribute to architecture-relevant aspects of regulatory, security and risk conversations.
  • Build a great place to work for talented and motivated people, and help develop innovative solutions with Bitcoin at their core.

Skills needed

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in an Architect, Staff or equivalent senior-IC role.
  • A strong track record as a hands-on engineer-turned-architect: you still read, write and review production code regularly, and you enjoy doing so. The role is language-agnostic, we care how you think, not which language you write, though familiarity with our primary stack is a plus.
  • Deep experience designing, building and operating distributed, event-driven systems in production, ideally at scale and under regulatory scrutiny.
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design, both strategic (bounded contexts, context mapping) and tactical patterns.
  • Practical familiarity with decentralised architectural governance, Architectural Advice Forum, RFCs and ADRs, and a clear point of view on why architectural decisions should be made close to the teams doing the work.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead by influence rather than authority: you have inspired engineers to adopt good practices because they wanted to, not because they were told to.
  • Experience working in regulated fintech, payments or banking environments, with an appreciation for the constraints that come with serving customers’ money.
  • Deep experience designing security-first architectures, threat modelling, secure-by-default patterns, defence in depth, identity, key and secret management, in environments where a breach has material business and regulatory consequences.
  • A strong perspective on modern AI/ML, LLMs, agents and applied AI in production, and how to integrate them responsibly into engineering workflows and customer-facing products.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can write a crisp ADR, run an effective architecture review, present to engineers and explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture, microservices, container-based 12-factor apps and patterns around fault tolerance, security and resilience.
  • Strong CI/CD, automated testing (unit, service and end-to-end) and overall SDLC practices.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience in crypto, Web3, custody or blockchain-based systems.
  • Familiarity with Team Topologies and how Stream Aligned, Platform and Enabling teams interact in practice.
  • Multi-platform standardisation experience spanning backend, web and mobile.
  • Background contributing to SRE or platform engineering work, SLOs, error budgets, developer experience.
  • Open-source contributions or external thought leadership (talks, articles, OSS projects).
  • Familiarity with Python, a meaningful portion of our stack is in Python, so it helps you hit the ground running, but the role is language-agnostic.

Other requirements

  • AWS as our cloud platform
  • GCP as our data warehousing
  • Containerised microservices
  • A multi-language stack
  • Based in or near a CET-compatible timezone
  • A dedicated workspace
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balanceBuild amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

  • Expect ExcellenceCollaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.
